violations.description: Untrusted PR head ref checked out under pull_request_target with write permissions
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/auto-label.yml uses pull_request_target and checks out ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
violations.recommendation: Avoid checking out untrusted PR head refs on pull_request_target workflows, or use pull_request instead.

violations.description: Hardcoded credential in workflow environment variables block
violations.recommendation: Use GitHub Secrets instead of hardcoding API keys or credentials in workflow files.

violations.description: Untrusted pull request title interpolated directly into shell run script
violations.recommendation: Pass untrusted event data via environment variables instead of direct shell interpolation.

violations.description: Untrusted workflow dispatch inputs interpolated directly into shell run script
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/manual-deploy.yml uses ${{ inputs.version }} and ${{ inputs.environment }} directly in shell run script
violations.recommendation: Pass workflow inputs via environment variables instead of direct shell interpolation.

violations.description: Missing permissions block in CI workflow
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs without an explicit permissions: block
violations.recommendation: Add an explicit permissions block (e.g. contents: read) to all jobs or workflows.
